OUR STORY

Understand the problem.
Make the solution useful.

Buddy Computers began with a practical approach to technology: solving real computer, technical and digital problems without making things unnecessarily difficult.

From PC and laptop repairs to custom builds, networking and digital work, our focus stays the same—understand what you need and provide a solution that helps.

We work directly with clients across Ahmedabad. Support is available at your home or office and remotely when suitable. If a device needs further repair, we arrange collection and return after discussing the work.

That same approach also led to Buddy Fleets, our website development work for transport and fleet operations.
